packet_dag.terminal_condition: One Time parent and student review routes mount role-scoped One Time helpers, keep helper threads under one_time_mishnah_class, avoid private billing/transcript/access/admin exposure, and pass focused tests plus deploy/live smoke.

title: One Time Parent Student Helper Scope

reasons: The public One Time helper shipped first, but the operator explicitly requested parent and student helper scope.
Parent and student helpers have different privacy boundaries: parent may ask about billing or attendance support, while student must not see parent billing or private parent messages.
The widget already supports One Time project scoping on the server, so this packet can stay limited to route detection, copy, visible actions, registry coverage, tests, and live smoke.
likely_external_provider_blockers: No live email, Stripe, payment, access grant, Zoom, Vimeo, Drive, WhatsApp, Telegram, DNS, credential, or external provider mutation is approved.
Real billing records, attendance records, transcript retrieval, and account password reset behavior remain outside this packet.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After this helper-scope patch, run the top-toolbar/filter density audit packet before any broader layout changes.

operator_intent_summary: The One Time helper should be available beyond the landing page and should feel scoped to the actual user: parents get trial, class-link, attendance, billing-support, and child-access guidance; students get class, library, worksheet, and Rabbi-question guidance without parent, admin, or cross-student data.
raw_quotes: the one-time Mission class helper so that also should exist on the actual landing page
scoped for the student their scope for the parents
the parents I guess it would just have more of the billing information and attendance
for the students it would just keep track of the classes and have the transcript of the classes and it would be able to reference to classes and the things that the rabbi said
there shouldn't be any overlap between The Branding of DNA and one time mishna

decisions_captured.decision: Implement only safe visible helper scope/copy/actions now; leave real billing, attendance, transcript/Rabbi-reference retrieval, and password/account mutation to authenticated packets.

out_of_scope: No live parent/student login email send.
No billing record display, payment, Stripe, charge, refund, or access grant.
No attendance record mutation or private attendance readback.
No transcript RAG, raw transcript retrieval, or Rabbi-statement retrieval.
No password reset, credential sharing, provider account write, DNS write, Drive/Vimeo/Zoom/WhatsApp/Telegram mutation, or external send.
affected_surfaces: One Time parent review helper launcher and panel
One Time student review helper launcher and panel

inspection_targets: public/js/bna-bot-widget.js returned early for all review=one-time routes, so parent/student review pages could not mount the universal helper.
server.js already normalizes one_time_parent and one_time_student surfaces to one_time_mishnah_class.
public/parent.html and public/student.html already include /js/bna-bot-widget.js and have Assistant/help topbar links.
ops/action-registry.json had a One Time public helper action but no parent/student helper launcher rows.
known_blockers: Real parent billing and attendance data need authenticated scoped data models and are not part of this visible-helper patch.
Student transcript/Rabbi-reference retrieval needs a separate privacy and source-corpus packet.

expanded_phrases.million-dollar app: Role-scoped helper behavior with clear copy, consistent One Time visual skin, registry coverage, tests, deploy proof, and explicit privacy boundaries.
expanded_phrases.scoped for the student: Student helper can guide class, library, worksheet, and Rabbi-question workflows, but cannot show parent billing, private parent messages, other students, raw transcripts, access codes, or admin data.
expanded_phrases.scoped for the parents: Parent helper can guide trial, schedule, child access, attendance-support, and billing-support next steps, but cannot mutate payments/access or expose raw billing records, transcripts, codes, other families, or admin data.
expanded_phrases.billing information: Visible helper copy can route billing-support questions; real billing display or payment mutation is out of scope.
expanded_phrases.attendance: Visible helper copy can route attendance-support questions; real attendance readback or mutation is out of scope.
expanded_phrases.transcript: Visible helper copy does not expose full transcripts; transcript/Rabbi-reference behavior requires a separate authenticated packet.
expanded_phrases.things that the rabbi said: Rabbi-reference search requires a separate source-corpus/privacy packet and is not implemented in this helper-scope pass.
expanded_phrases.overlap between branding: One Time parent/student helper surfaces use One Time helper title and black/yellow skin instead of generic BNA helper chrome.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Use the first-party BNA universal helper widget and existing assistant project scoping, not an external CRM or provider runtime.

requirements.statement: One Time parent and student review routes must mount role-scoped One Time helpers without inheriting generic BNA helper copy or BNA-blue helper chrome.
requirements.expected_result: The parent review route shows One Time Parent Helper and the student review route shows One Time Student Helper, both with One Time styling and route-specific safe prompt chips.
acceptance_criteria: Widget does not return early for parent/student review=one-time routes.
Widget maps parent review to one_time_parent and student review to one_time_student.
Parent helper copy names trial, schedule, child access, billing-support, attendance-support, and Rabbi-question guidance.
Student helper copy names class, library, worksheets, and Rabbi-question guidance.
Both helpers forbid private billing, transcripts, access codes, cross-family/cross-student data, and admin data.

requirements.statement: One Time parent/student helper launchers must be registered and live-smoked.
requirements.expected_result: Action and route registries cover both helper launchers and parent/student review routes, focused tests pass, and shared-review live smoke proves deployed helper text.
acceptance_criteria: Production shared-review live smoke checks both helper titles.

criteria: Raw source and parent packet exist.
Affected routes are limited to parent/student One Time review and assistant chat surface context.
Existing server scoping for one_time_parent and one_time_student is present.
No external sends, payment/access, transcript retrieval, or credential mutation is needed.
